## Project Survival Analysis exploration

Based on cds data base from the full study git.

## Data loading + packages

Load all needed packages.

```{r}
library(survival)
library(DESeq2)
library(GSVA)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyverse)
library(survminer)
```

Set working directory and load the dataset.

```{r}
clean_clinical_TMB <- readRDS("data/processed/clean_clinical_TMB.rds")
clean_clinical_TNB <- readRDS("data/processed/clean_clinical_TNB.rds")

glimpse(clean_clinical_TMB)
glimpse(clean_clinical_TNB)
```

### Helper functions

```{r}
# Convert a survdiff() chi-squared statistic to a p-value.
lr_p <- function(x) {
  pchisq(x$chisq, df = length(x$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

# Draw a Kaplan–Meier curve with confidence bands, a risk table, and p-value.
km_plot <- function(fit, title, p) {
  ggsurvfit(fit, linewidth = 1) +
    add_confidence_interval() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "Log-rank p = ",
        format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)
      ),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4
    ) +
    add_risktable(
      risktable_stats = c("n.risk", "cum.event"),
      stats_label = c("At risk", "Events")
    ) +
    scale_ggsurvfit() +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Overall survival (months)",
      y = "Overall survival probability",
      color = "Group",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

## TMB Survival Analysis

Several variable to check : PD vs SD, R vs NR, IC level, TMB, TNB, TC level, ....

Begin by inspecting TMB distribution to find a good cut-off point.

```{r}
ggplot(clean_clinical_TMB, 
       aes(x= FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB)) + 
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(title = "TMB Distribution")
```

Looks like a Negative binomiale distribution, thus taking median value would create imbalanced groups.

```{r}
ggplot(clean_clinical_TMB, 
       aes(x= log(FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB+1))) + 
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(title = "TMB Distribution")
```

### Whole cohort

```{r}
#Find the optimal cutpoint for TMB against overall survival
cut_tmb <- surv_cutpoint(
  data = clean_clinical_TMB,
  time = "os",
  event = "censOS",
  variables = "FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB",
  minprop = 0.1
)

summary(cut_tmb)
plot(cut_tmb, "FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB", palette = "npg")

#Categorize patients into High vs. Low TMB using the cutpoint
cat_tmb <- surv_categorize(cut_tmb)
```

```{r}
# Add the new factor column back to your clinical data frame
clean_clinical_TMB <- clean_clinical_TMB |> 
  mutate(TMB_Cutpoint_Group = cat_tmb$FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB)

table(clean_clinical_TMB$TMB_Cutpoint_Group)

fit_tmb <- survfit(Surv(os, censOS) ~ TMB_Cutpoint_Group,
                   data = clean_clinical_TMB)
lr_tmb <- survdiff(Surv(os, censOS) ~ TMB_Cutpoint_Group,
                   data = clean_clinical_TMB)

km_plot(fit_tmb,
        "Survival analysis stratified by TMB",
        lr_p(lr_tmb))
```

### Stratified by responder/non responder

```{r}
df_r <- clean_clinical_TMB |> 
  filter(Responder_Group == "R")

cut_tmb_r <- surv_cutpoint(
  data = df_r,
  time = "os",
  event = "censOS",
  variables = "FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB",
  minprop = 0.1
)

summary(cut_tmb_r)
plot(cut_tmb_r, "FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB", palette = "npg")

cat_tmb_r <- surv_categorize(cut_tmb_r)

df_r <- df_r |> 
  mutate(TMB_Cutpoint_Group = cat_tmb_r$FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB)
```

```{r}
df_nr <- clean_clinical_TMB |> 
  filter(Responder_Group == "NR")

cut_tmb_nr <- surv_cutpoint(
  data = df_nr,
  time = "os",
  event = "censOS",
  variables = "FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB",
  minprop = 0.1
)

summary(cut_tmb_nr)
plot(cut_tmb_nr, "FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB", palette = "npg")

cat_tmb_nr <- surv_categorize(cut_tmb_nr)

df_nr <- df_nr |> 
  mutate(TMB_Cutpoint_Group = cat_tmb_nr$FMOne.mutation.burden.per.MB)
```

```{r}
table(df_r$TMB_Cutpoint_Group)
```

```{r}
table(df_nr$TMB_Cutpoint_Group)
```

```{r}
fit_tmb_r <- survfit(Surv(os, censOS) ~ TMB_Cutpoint_Group,
                   data = df_r)
lr_tmb_r <- survdiff(Surv(os, censOS) ~ TMB_Cutpoint_Group,
                   data = df_r)

km_plot(fit_tmb_r,
        "Survival analysis stratified by TMB for the Responder Group",
        lr_p(lr_tmb_r))
```

```{r}
fit_tmb_nr <- survfit(Surv(os, censOS) ~ TMB_Cutpoint_Group,
                     data = df_nr)
lr_tmb_nr <- survdiff(Surv(os, censOS) ~ TMB_Cutpoint_Group,
                     data = df_nr)

km_plot(fit_tmb_nr,
        "Survival analysis stratified by TMB for the Non-Responder Group",
        lr_p(lr_tmb_nr))
```

```{r}
table(df_nr$Best.Confirmed.Overall.Response, df_nr$TMB_Cutpoint_Group)
```
